summary: Four churches in one family (BP = Our Lady of Lourdes Bemus Point, M = St. Mary Mayville, FC = Christ Our Hope = St. Matthias Clymer, W = St. Dominic = St. James Major Westfield). sources.said: ...decided to discontinue the Celebration of First Saturday Masses at St. Dominic's Parish. Poor attendance, pastoral needs, and parish time concerns

slots.rationale: R30/R28: The Saturday 4:00 PM Mass at Westfield is printed every week. On the first Saturday (Oct 3) the Mass listing, which is complete (it even says 'NO SCHEDULED MASS' for Thursdays), shows no Mass other than the 4:00 PM, so the discontinued 'First Saturday Mass' may be that 4:00 PM Mass. The newest calendar says 'FIRST SATURDAY - NO MASS' on Nov 7 but never says the vigil is cancelled (R17). Leaning to every Saturday except the first because a wrong Mass time is worse than a missing one; History cancelled only Nov 7 at 4 PM.
slots.question: Keep the Westfield (St. Dominic) Saturday 4:00 PM Mass on first Saturdays?
